In priority group 1, the average weekly number of opera- tions per 100 patients listed declined from 42.4 (34.6– 50.2) in the 1991–92 cohort to 20.3 (17.7–22.9) in the 1995–96 cohort to 12.2 (9.2–15.3) in the 1999–2000 cohort (data not shown). Corresponding HRs and 95% CIs are shown in Table 5, columns 2 and 3. The condi- tional weekly probabilities of undergoing surgery were 34% lower for the 1995–96 cohort, HR = 0.66 (0.50– 0.87), and 53% lower for the 1999–2000 cohort, HR = 0.47 (0.33–0.68), relative to 1991–92. There was a differ- ence in the distribution of wait-list times between 1995– 96 and 1999–2000 cohorts (chi-square = 9.9, P = 0.0017, 1 df).
